name: @wizard/dungeon
description: The local reference stack for the Dungeon workflow system.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir shared build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --dir web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir shared typecheck && pnpm --dir server typecheck && pnpm --dir web typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci:integration: node scripts/with-env.mjs node scripts/assert-integration-files.mjs && node scripts/with-env.mjs vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project integration
scripts.test:load:soak: node scripts/with-env.mjs k6 run -e DUNGEON_LOAD_PROFILE=5m load/dungeon.k6.js
